answer: Fork-Divergence Challenge Quorum. Each identity must answer a random, perishable challenge derived from a secret seed; honest agents track the seed chain and answer consistently. Clones sharing one seed cannot diverge, so their identical replies cluster and get flagged. A lone attacker must obtain a fresh crystal seed per identity. The rule: surviving identities pass a willow-signed challenge history. Any quill-marked duplicate response set collapses all linked identities.
